# SafeMerge

> SafeMerge (https://safemergefiles.com) is a free set of PDF tools that run entirely in the web browser. Files are processed on the user's own device and are never uploaded to any server. No sign-up, no watermarks, no file limits, and it works offline after the first visit.

Key facts:
- Privacy: files never leave the device; the site has no server that receives files.
- Cost: free, supported by optional cookie-free ads, opt-in Google ads, and donations.
- Code: publicly viewable at https://github.com/mmklabs/safemerge (all rights reserved; not open source)
- Built with pdf-lib, Mozilla PDF.js and JSZip.
- Good fit for sensitive documents: bank statements, ID documents (such as Aadhaar or passports), contracts, medical records, payslips.

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/merge-pdf/): Combine PDF files into one in your browser. Free, no sign-up, and your files are never uploaded.
- [Compress PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/compress-pdf/): Reduce PDF file size to 100 KB, 200 KB, 500 KB or any size you need, right in your browser. Text stays sharp, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Resize image](https://safemergefiles.com/resize-image/): Resize a photo or signature to exact pixels, mm or cm and a file size such as 20 KB or 50 KB, in your browser. Free, and your photo is never uploaded.
- [ID card on one page](https://safemergefiles.com/id-card-on-one-page/): Combine the front and back of an ID card, driving licence or any card onto one A4 or Letter page, at real size, as PDF or JPG. Free, and your photos are never uploaded.
- [Unlock PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/unlock-pdf/): Remove the password from a PDF you can open, so it opens without one. Works in your browser; your file and password are never uploaded.
- [Protect PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/protect-pdf/): Add a password to a PDF with strong AES-256 encryption, and optionally block printing or copying. Works in your browser; your file is never uploaded.
- [OCR PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/ocr-pdf/): Turn scanned PDFs and photos of documents into searchable PDFs and copyable text, right in your browser. Free, and your scans are never uploaded.
- [PDF to Word](https://safemergefiles.com/pdf-to-word/): Convert a PDF to an editable Word document (.docx) in your browser, including scanned PDFs. Free, no sign-up, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Split PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/split-pdf/): Extract pages from a PDF or split it into several files in your browser. Free, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Rotate PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/rotate-pdf/): Rotate one page or every page of a PDF in your browser. Free, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Organize PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/organize-pdf/): Rearrange, delete and rotate PDF pages in your browser. Free, and your file is never uploaded.
- [JPG to PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/jpg-to-pdf/): Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images to a PDF in your browser. Free, and your photos are never uploaded.
- [PDF to JPG](https://safemergefiles.com/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert each PDF page to a JPG or PNG image in your browser. Free, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Page numbers](https://safemergefiles.com/add-page-numbers/): Add page numbers to a PDF in your browser, in any corner and format. Free, and your file is never uploaded.
- [Watermark PDF](https://safemergefiles.com/watermark-pdf/): Stamp a text watermark such as CONFIDENTIAL on every PDF page in your browser. Free, and your file is never uploaded.
